title: Kara Leier
text:
About me, professionally
LinkedIn
I hold three degrees: Master of Data Science (Computational Linguistics), B.A. Honours in Linguistics, and B.Sc. 3 year in Computer Science.
In my undergraduate honours thesis I worked with a low-resource language, Dëne Sųłıné. In my masters, I continued to learn about what to do with minimal or sparse data. From there, I began working as a Research Analyst at VIDO in Saskatoon, SK. At VIDO, I apply my computational linguistic expertise to answer questions in immunology. Stay tuned :)
Current position: Research Analyst @ VIDO
Research interests: computational linguistics, interdisciplinary approaches to problems, low-resource research


About me, personally
I have been learning to crochet recently and really love to try to make various items. My favourites have been keychains, coasters, decor items, and even wearables!
Since finishing school, I have been able to pick up my instruments again (guitar and ukulele). My hands are no longer calloused and I will need to regain that strength! I also joined a choir after a 1-year break:)
Lastly, I stepped out of my comfort zone and joined a darts league with my dad and his fiance. Wish me luck!
